name: Singify — Karaoke
description: SingStar-style karaoke inside Spotify: UltraStar charts, a scrolling lyric + pitch highway over the player, and mic scoring for 1-4 players. Load an UltraStar .txt chart for a song and it's remembered and auto-synced to Spotify's lyrics; a local helper (bun run helper) adds automatic chart download from USDB. Built and tested on Linux.
